shells.description: Asset Administration Shells. Each Group is one AAS - the digital representation of one asset - and holds the Submodels that describe it. The Group id is the symbolic identifier of the AAS Identifiable id

aasidentifier.name: aasidentifier
aasidentifier.description: The AAS Identifiable id as authored, an IRI, IRDI or URN of up to 2048 characters. It is the Group source identity and the authority: the shellid is the symbolic identifier constructed from it, a one-way construction that is never inverted

idshort.name: idshort
idshort.description: The AAS idShort, a short human-readable name that is unique only within its parent and is therefore never used as an identifier

assetkind.name: assetkind
assetkind.description: The kind of asset this shell represents. Type is a product model, Instance an individual item and Batch a production lot, matching the three granularity levels a product passport is issued at

globalassetid.name: globalassetid
globalassetid.description: The globally unique identifier of the asset itself, as distinct from the shell that describes it. Where the asset carries an identification link this is that link

assettype.name: assettype
assettype.description: The identifier of the asset type this asset is an occurrence of

specificassetids.name: specificassetids
specificassetids.description: Additional domain-specific keys the asset is discoverable by, such as a serial number, a manufacturer part id or a batch id

name.name: name
name.description: The key name, for example serialNumber or manufacturerPartId

externalsubjectid.name: externalsubjectid
externalsubjectid.description: The identifier of the subject this key is disclosed to, so that a registry can restrict which callers see it

derivedfrom.name: derivedfrom
derivedfrom.description: The Type shell this Instance shell was derived from, so that an individual item can be traced to its product model

administration.name: administration
administration.description: The AAS administrative information. It records a single current revision only: the lifecycle history of the shell is carried by xRegistry Versions, which the AAS metamodel has no equivalent of

revision.name: revision
revision.description: The AAS revision label, only meaningful when version is present

templateid.name: templateid
templateid.description: The identifier of the specification template this shell was built from

creator.name: creator
creator.description: The identifier of the party that created this shell

disclosuretier.name: disclosuretier
disclosuretier.description: Whether this entity is readable without authentication or requires an authenticated role. It advertises the tier so a Consumer can discover it; it does not enforce it

authorization.name: authorization
authorization.description: The authorization options a Consumer may use to obtain access to this entity, in the shape defined by the xRegistry Endpoint Registry. It is authorization configuration only and MUST NOT carry credentials

type.name: type
type.description: The authorization type, for example OAuth2, Plain, SASL, X509Cert or APIKey

mechanism.name: mechanism
mechanism.description: The SASL mechanism name, used only when type is SASL

resourceuri.name: resourceuri
resourceuri.description: The URI of the resource authorization is requested for

authorityuri.name: authorityuri
authorityuri.description: The URI of the authority authorization is obtained from

eventendpoint.name: eventendpoint
eventendpoint.description: The Endpoint Registry entry that delivers change events for this shell, where one is published. It is a URL rather than an xid because the Endpoint Registry serving it is usually a different registry, and an xid is resolved relative to the registry that carries it

submodels.description: A Submodel served as a document. Each Version is one revision of the Submodel, giving the shell a lifecycle history that the AAS metamodel does not itself provide

format.name: format
format.description: The serialization format of the document. The AAS-Submodel formats are the Submodel as defined by the AAS metamodel; the EN18223 formats are the product passport serializations derived from it

submodelidentifier.name: submodelidentifier
submodelidentifier.description: The Submodel Identifiable id as authored. It is the Resource source identity and the authority: the submodelid is the symbolic identifier constructed from it, a one-way construction that is never inverted

semanticid.name: semanticid
semanticid.description: The identifier of the concept this Submodel is an occurrence of, which is what makes a Submodel discoverable by meaning rather than by name

supplementalsemanticids.name: supplementalsemanticids
supplementalsemanticids.description: Further concept identifiers this Submodel corresponds to, used to carry the same meaning across more than one dictionary

kind.name: kind
kind.description: Whether this Submodel carries values for one asset or defines the shape other Submodels are built from

idshort.name: idshort
idshort.description: The AAS idShort, unique only within its parent and therefore never used as an identifier

template.name: template
template.description: The identifier of the Submodel Template this Submodel was built from, as authored. It is an identifier rather than a pointer so that it resolves the same way whether or not this registry also serves the template

digest.name: digest
digest.description: Lower-case hexadecimal digest of the exact document bytes a Consumer retrieves, computed with digestalg

digestalg.name: digestalg
digestalg.description: The algorithm used to compute digest. REQUIRED when digest is present

disclosuretier.name: disclosuretier
disclosuretier.description: Whether this document is readable without authentication or requires an authenticated role. A document is wholly one or the other: a tier boundary that falls between elements inside a document cannot be expressed here

authorization.name: authorization
authorization.description: The authorization options a Consumer may use to obtain access to this document, in the shape defined by the xRegistry Endpoint Registry. It is authorization configuration only and MUST NOT carry credentials

type.name: type
type.description: The authorization type, for example OAuth2, Plain, SASL, X509Cert or APIKey

mechanism.name: mechanism
mechanism.description: The SASL mechanism name, used only when type is SASL

resourceuri.name: resourceuri
resourceuri.description: The URI of the resource authorization is requested for

authorityuri.name: authorityuri
authorityuri.description: The URI of the authority authorization is obtained from

submodeltemplates.description: Submodel Template families. Each Group is one publisher's template namespace and holds the Submodels whose kind is Template. The submodels Resource type is imported from the shells Group so that a template and the Submodels built from it are the same Resource model type

publisher.name: publisher
publisher.description: The organization that publishes this template family

conceptdictionaries.description: Concept dictionaries. Each Group is one dictionary whose entries give meaning to the semanticid values used elsewhere in this registry

dictionary.name: dictionary
dictionary.description: The dictionary this Group mirrors, for example an industry classification system or a standards body's common data dictionary

conceptdescriptions.description: A Concept Description served as a document: the definition a semanticid resolves to

format.name: format
format.description: The serialization format of the document

conceptidentifier.name: conceptidentifier
conceptidentifier.description: The Concept Description Identifiable id as authored, which is the value a semanticid elsewhere in this registry refers to. It is the Resource source identity and the authority

idshort.name: idshort
idshort.description: The AAS idShort, unique only within its parent and therefore never used as an identifier

iscaseof.name: iscaseof
iscaseof.description: The identifiers of concepts in other dictionaries this concept corresponds to

aasxregistries.description: Package stores. Each Group is one store holding AASX packages, and where that store is an OCI registry the Group is one registry or namespace within it. Defined by the AAS package binding rather than by the AAS registry model

registryurl.name: registryurl
registryurl.description: The base URL of the backing package store

namespace.name: namespace
namespace.description: The namespace within the backing store that this Group covers

packages.description: An AASX package served as a document. Each Version is one immutable release of the package, addressed by digest and optionally attested by signatures

format.name: format
format.description: The package format of the document

packageidentifier.name: packageidentifier
packageidentifier.description: The package name as held by the backing store, which for an OCI registry is the repository name. It is the Resource source identity and the authority

artifacttype.name: artifacttype
artifacttype.description: The media type that identifies what this artifact is, carried by the backing store where it supports one

digest.name: digest
digest.description: Lower-case hexadecimal digest of the exact package bytes a Consumer retrieves, computed with digestalg. This is the integrity anchor: a tag identifies a Version, a digest identifies its content

digestalg.name: digestalg
digestalg.description: The algorithm used to compute digest. REQUIRED when digest is present

aasidentifiers.name: aasidentifiers
aasidentifiers.description: The AAS Identifiable ids contained in this package, so a Consumer can tell what a package holds without retrieving and opening it

shell.name: shell
shell.description: The shell this package is the packaged form of, where the same registry also serves it as a Group

subject.name: subject
subject.description: The digest of the artifact this one is attached to, where this artifact is a signature, attestation or other referrer rather than a package in its own right

attestations.name: attestations
attestations.description: The signatures and attestations attached to this package, which a Consumer verifies before trusting its contents

artifacttype.name: artifacttype
artifacttype.description: The media type identifying what kind of attestation this is

digest.name: digest
digest.description: The digest of the attestation artifact

signer.name: signer
signer.description: The identifier of the party that produced the attestation
